registration.title: A curve relearning the margin's error
registration.what: Relearn, every half-season, how the expected margin's error depends on the margin itself, so mismatches are no longer too flat.
registration.why: A fixed sharpening failed because the error it corrects moves over time; one that relearns might follow it.
registration.how: A ridge regression of the margin's error on the margin (straight or curved, with or without a term for cups), on two or four years of matches or all of them.
registration.hypothesis: A relearned curve improves the result probabilities where a fixed one could not.
registration.success_criteria: Fixed before the grid ran: the best of 24 settings must improve the selection window by 0.0002 over the goal level alone.

events.label: Best of 24 settings over the goal level alone, selection window
events.meaningful: No. Under half of what it needed.

events.reason: Not chosen on development. The flat ends are absent before 2024, so nothing fitted on those years can see them. A formula on the model's own recent errors also added nothing.
